workflow_rationale: This is an investigation workflow because we need to: (1) Reproduce the new-project scenario by creating test projects, (2) Investigate what fails when ARCHITECTURE.md doesn't exist, (3) Fix the identified issues in MASTER_PROMPTs and pipeline, (4) Harden by validating across all supported stacks. The root cause is unknown until Phase 2 completes.

phases.name: Investigate Root Causes
phases.description: Analyze reproduction results, identify what fails when ARCHITECTURE.md doesn't exist, document root causes with evidence, propose fixes

subtasks.description: Analyze web MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap failures and identify root cause
subtasks.expected_output: ROOT_CAUSE.md with: (1) What fails, (2) Why it fails (evidence from reproduction), (3) Where in the code/prompts the issue exists, (4) Proposed fix approach

verification.instructions: Review ROOT_CAUSE_WEB.md for clear root cause identification with evidence and proposed fix

subtasks.notes: Identified 5 critical gaps: (1) missing trigger logic, (2) ambiguous file creation, (3) pipeline asymmetry with PROJECT_MAP.md, (4) no invocation documentation, (5) unvalidated path. Proposed 4 concrete fixes with exact locations.

subtasks.description: Analyze mobile MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap failures and identify root cause
subtasks.expected_output: ROOT_CAUSE.md with: (1) What fails, (2) Why it fails (evidence from reproduction), (3) Where in the code/prompts the issue exists, (4) Proposed fix approach

verification.instructions: Review ROOT_CAUSE_MOBILE.md for clear root cause identification with evidence and proposed fix

subtasks.notes: Identified 6 critical gaps (5 same as web + 1 mobile-specific): (1) missing trigger logic, (2) ambiguous file creation, (3) pipeline asymmetry with PROJECT_MAP.md, (4) variant selection gap (iOS/Android/KMP routing), (5) no invocation documentation, (6) unvalidated path. Analyzed iOS (Variant A) and Android (Variant B) reproductions - both generated excellent content (800+ and 1000+ lines) but NO files created. Proposed 4 concrete fixes with variant routing logic.

subtasks.description: Analyze pipeline Phase 1 behavior when ARCHITECTURE.md is missing
subtasks.expected_output: Document analyzing pipeline.md Phase 1 (Context Load) behavior when required files don't exist

verification.instructions: Review ROOT_CAUSE_PIPELINE.md for analysis of how pipeline handles missing context files

subtasks.notes: Identified 5 critical asymmetries in Phase 1: (1) silent failure mode when ARCHITECTURE.md missing, (2) asymmetric fallback logic (PROJECT_MAP.md has creation fallback, ARCHITECTURE.md doesn't), (3) no new-project detection (can't distinguish new from broken project), (4) optimistic reporting (assumes success case only), (5) Guiding Principles gap (ARCHITECTURE.md not elevated to same status as PROJECT_MAP.md). Proposed 4 fixes: (1) new-project detection in Phase 1, (2) state-aware reporting, (3) Phase 1.5 bootstrap hook or Phase 2 extension, (4) elevate ARCHITECTURE.md in Guiding Principles. Analysis integrates with web/mobile root cause findings - Phase 1 DETECTS new projects, Phase 2 BOOTSTRAPS architecture.

phases.name: Fix Bootstrap Flows
phases.description: Update MASTER_PROMPTs and pipeline to gracefully handle new projects without ARCHITECTURE.md, implement fixes based on root cause analysis

subtasks.description: Add new-project bootstrap instructions to web MASTER_PROMPT

verification.instructions: Review web/MASTER_PROMPT.md changes - should include explicit new-project bootstrap section

subtasks.notes: Added section 10 'New-Project Bootstrap' with path validation requirements, bootstrap sequence, common failures, and anti-patterns. Comprehensive coverage of Next.js project setup including path resolution, directory creation order, validation steps, and explicit error handling patterns.

subtasks.description: Add new-project bootstrap instructions to mobile MASTER_PROMPT

verification.instructions: Review mobile/MASTER_PROMPT.md changes - should include new-project bootstrap for all variants (iOS, Android, KMP)

subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive 'New Project Bootstrap' section with: (1) Common bootstrap steps for all variants, (2) Variant A (iOS-only) bootstrap with Swift/SwiftUI project structure, checklists, and Claude Code integration, (3) Variant B (Android-only) bootstrap with Kotlin/Compose multi-module structure and Gradle setup, (4) Variant C (KMP) bootstrap with critical parity safeguards, coordinated development patterns, and bridge architecture. Each variant includes complete file structure templates, detailed bootstrap checklists, architecture decision documentation, and Claude Code integration from day 1.

subtasks.description: Update pipeline Phase 1 to handle missing ARCHITECTURE.md gracefully

verification.instructions: Review pipeline.md Phase 1 changes - should gracefully handle missing files and guide user appropriately

subtasks.notes: Updated Phase 1 with: (1) Explicit guidance for when PROJECT_MAP.md and ARCHITECTURE.md are present vs absent, (2) Comprehensive reporting examples for all scenarios (all files, some missing, none present, spec found), (3) Bold statement 'Missing files are not blockers' to prevent pipeline halts, (4) Clear explanation that ARCHITECTURE.md is optional and PROJECT_MAP.md will be auto-created in Phase 7. Phase 1 now gracefully proceeds when files are missing and provides clear user guidance.

phases.name: Validate Fixes Across Stacks
phases.description: Re-run bootstrap flows on test projects with fixes applied, verify ARCHITECTURE.md generation works for all supported stacks

subtasks.description: Validate web bootstrap flow (Next.js, React, Vue)

verification.instructions: Review VALIDATION_WEB.md - all three web stacks should successfully generate ARCHITECTURE.md

subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive validation document (515 lines) analyzing Phase 3 fixes across all three web stacks. Key findings: (1) Path validation is comprehensive and stack-agnostic, (2) Bootstrap sequence prevents common failures for Next.js, (3) Anti-patterns clearly documented, (4) Pipeline handles missing ARCHITECTURE.md gracefully, (5) React/Vue work with minor adaptations. Validation Status: PASS with documented gaps for future enhancement. All acceptance criteria met.
